+  def normalize_path(path)
+    # Normalize path: resolve . and .. segments
+    # /path/to/./file becomes /path/to/file
+    # /path/to/file/.. becomes /path/to
+    segments = path.split('/').reject { |seg| seg.empty? || seg == '.' }
+    normalized = []
+
+    segments.each do |segment|
+      if segment == '..'
+        normalized.pop if normalized.any?
+      else
+        normalized << segment
+      end
+    end
+
+    '/' + normalized.join('/')
+  end
 end

+  def read_from_clipboard
+    uname = `uname 2>/dev/null`.strip
+    case uname
+    when 'Darwin'
+      `pbpaste 2>/dev/null`.chomp
+    else
+      # Try wayland clipboard (Linux)
+      `wl-paste --no-newline 2>/dev/null`.chomp rescue nil
+    end
+  rescue StandardError
+    nil
+  end
